solution.title: Microsoft Teams → Google Chat & Meet Migration & Coexistence

products.name: Microsoft Teams → Google Chat & Meet Migration & Coexistence — Commercial
products.short_description: Migrate Microsoft Teams to Google Chat and Meet — channels→spaces, meetings, coexistence, and adoption — so collaboration continues without stranding users, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Move collaboration from Teams to Chat and Meet without stranding users

Teams isn't just chat — it's channels, meetings, and files, and users are mid-conversation when you migrate. This solution moves Microsoft Teams to Google Chat and Meet with a spaces/channel mapping, meetings transition, coexistence during the cutover, and user-adoption guidance, so collaboration continues without stranding people, executed pilot-first and rollback-ready.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the Teams → Chat/Meet model (channels→spaces, meetings, shared files, coexistence) and the deployment model.
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites (source Teams access, Google tenant/licensing, tooling where used, a pilot) with how to verify/implement each.
  • Implementation Guide — exact steps to map Teams channels to Google Chat spaces, transition meetings to Meet, handle coexistence during cutover, run a named pilot, validate, and expand.
  • 5 supporting scripts — Teams estate discovery, per-team migration/coexistence validation, a coverage/adoption report, safe remediation, and a wave target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (spaces created, meetings work, users active) plus Best Practices for adoption and coexistence.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Collaboration moved from Teams to Chat and Meet — spaces mapped, meetings transitioned, users kept active through coexistence — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • GWCHAT-Discovery.ps1 — baseline the Microsoft Teams source estate for a Chat & Meet migration
    • GWCHAT-Remediation.ps1 — safe remediation of wave/space readiness data gaps in a members or mapping CSV
    • GWCHAT-Report.ps1 — render Teams -> Chat/Meet migration coverage and adoption
    • GWCHAT-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build a migration wave's target group in Microsoft Entra
    • GWCHAT-Validation.ps1 — confirm per-team migration and coexistence readiness before a cutover

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
